exam_format: Multiple Choice (VCP/VCAP Design); Hands-on Lab (VCAP Deploy); Panel Defense (VCDX)

testing_centers.notes: VCP and VCAP written/design exams via Pearson VUE test centers or OnVUE online proctoring

id_requirements: Government-issued photo ID required. ID must match the name on the exam registration. Acceptable forms include passport, driver's license, or national ID card.
exam_rules: Closed-book exam for VCP and VCAP written/design exams. No notes, study materials, or electronic devices permitted. Personal items must be stored. No food or drink. VCAP Deploy lab exams are hands-on in a live vSphere environment — no closed-book restriction applies to the lab interface. VCDX panel defense requires submitting a design documentation package in advance.
renewal_options: All VMware certifications are valid for 2 years. Renewal requires passing the current version of the exam or a higher-level exam in the same track before expiry. No CE credit option — exam retake is the only renewal path.

retake_policy.notes: 15-day waiting period between retake attempts for VCP and VCAP written/design exams. VCAP lab and VCDX panel defense retake scheduling is coordinated with VMware/Broadcom directly.

editorial.meta_description: Prepare for the VCAP-DCV Deploy exam covering installation, configuration, setup, performance tuning, troubleshooting, administrative tasks, and operational.
editorial.overview: The VCAP-DCV Deploy certification exam is officially published and supported by VMware (Broadcom). It evaluates advanced technical skills across four domains covering installation, configuration, setup, performance-tuning, optimization, upgrades, troubleshooting, repairing, administrative, and operational tasks required for modern enterprise virtualization environments. Candidates must demonstrate proficiency in managing complex vSphere infrastructures to meet the established standards set by the certification program for deployment professionals during the 205-minute examination period, which costs 350 USD.
editorial.who_should_take: This advanced certification is specifically designed for experienced virtualization administrators and infrastructure engineers with hands-on experience deploying, configuring, and managing complex VMware vSphere enterprise environments who want to validate their advanced deployment capabilities.
editorial.preparation_strategy: Review the official VMware (Broadcom) documentation for ESXi installation guidelines, vCenter Server deployment procedures, and advanced auto deploy configurations. Practice hands-on labs focusing on management, configuration, storage settings, system maintenance, and component upgrades to ensure readiness for the practical tasks required during the 205-minute examination period, keeping in mind the registration fee of 350 USD.

domain_guidance.summary: This domain focuses on successfully installing, configuring, and setting up core vSphere components including standalone ESXi hosts, distributed vCenter Server appliances, advanced networking configurations, and shared storage elements within a virtualized data center environment.

This domain covers performance-tuning methodologies, infrastructure optimization strategies, and systematic upgrade paths for ESXi hosts, vCenter Server instances, and all related virtualization and hardware infrastructure components to ensure high availability and efficient resource utilization.

This domain involves advanced troubleshooting procedures and repairing complex issues related to boot sequences, software upgrades, failed deployments, faulty configurations, and core enterprise services that maintain the stability of the virtualized infrastructure environment.

This domain addresses administrative and operational tasks such as certificate management, authentication services setup, reliable backups, and proper licensing compliance across the enterprise architecture to maintain security and operational integrity of the system.

editorial.exam_day_guidance: Manage your time efficiently across the 205-minute duration of the examination. Read every individual lab prompt carefully and verify all system configurations before proceeding to the next task to ensure accuracy and successful completion of the practical requirements.

faq.question_title: How much does the exam cost?
faq.answer_text: The official exam registration fee is priced at 350 USD. Please check directly with VMware (Broadcom) for registration details, scheduling procedures, and payment policies to ensure you have the most current information regarding your specific testing location and requirements.

The required passing score is 300 on a scaled scoring system ranging from 100 to 500 points for all qualified candidates. You must achieve this threshold to earn the certification and validate your technical deployment skills.

The exam has an exact duration of 205 minutes to complete all required practical tasks and administrative questions successfully. Ensure you pace yourself throughout the session to address every lab requirement within the allotted time frame provided.

faq.question_title: How long is the certification valid?
faq.answer_text: The certification validity period is exactly 2 years, and successful recertification or renewal is required to maintain an active certified status. Please monitor your certification expiration date to ensure you remain compliant with the current program standards.
